meta.fire_source: CWFIS FireM3 2026 perimeters, file stamped 2026-10-20 (hotspot-derived outlines, preliminary); 13 outlines classed agricultural/grass burn or military range with no agency-reported fire excluded (analysis/outline-check)
meta.smoke_source: NAPS validated 2018-2024 + AirNow real-time 2024-2026 (city mean of stations, 24 h PM2.5); counts days with mean > 27, > 60, > 100 ug/m3; 2026 to Oct 19
meta.cost_note: Provincial definitions differ (BC BCWS total cost; ON Emergency Fire Fighting net of recoveries; AB all wildfire program lines; SK season costs in 2025 dollars). Not comparable across provinces. Per resident uses 2021 Census population.
